function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find

Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_find
function.description: Find available actions by case-insensitive literal substring of the action name and description. Use the empty string to list all available actions with pagination; wildcard and semantic searches are not supported. Returns exact total and continuation cursor; pass the returned cursor to continue. Submit at most one tool call per response.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of name and description; use the empty string to list all available actions. No wildcard or semantic matching.

function.name: action_describe
function.description: Read the full parameter schema, tags and completion metadata for one action before invoking it. Eligibility is checked again when the action runs. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: action_invoke
function.description: Execute one domain action. arguments follows the described action schema; accepted is not completed. Every attempt uses the domain action budget. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: ls
function.description: List authorized immediate directory children. Returns exact total, revision and next_cursor; pass that cursor to continue. Listing does not read large bodies. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: read
function.description: Read an original file by absolute path, with byte offset and size. Start at /context, /world, /workspace or /results. Defaults to UTF-8; base64 preserves binary bytes. Follow next_offset until null and keep expected_revision when continuing. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: find
function.description: Find original logical file paths using a glob pattern under path. Returns total and next_cursor; pass the cursor to continue. Transmission parts and metadata are not duplicate search targets. Submit at most one tool call per response.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search original text files by line using ripgrep regex, or literal text when literal=true. Returns line and byte locations, exact completed total and a persistent JSONL result_path; read that file to obtain all matches. glob selects file paths. Source changes invalidate the search. Submit at most one tool call per response.
